blocks.text: Mobile and manufactured homes in Rosedale
Verified park on this ground: 1 — Mt Cheam Mobile Home Park, pad rental, families allowed, NOT 55+.

items.t: Mt Cheam Mobile Home Park: Plainly: a home here sits on a rented pad — the buyer owns the home (a chattel) and rents the pad; the buyer does not own the land.
Age position: a current listing states "Although Mostly Senior Occupied, and very Quiet, Families are ALLOWED." Senior-occupied is not an age restriction.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Rosedale

items.t: Rosedale is an unincorporated community east of Chilliwack in FVRD Electoral Area D; the FVRD places its Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park (53480 Elgey Road, Rosedale) in Electoral Area D and states it governs its eight electoral areas.

Transit: BC Transit Route 71 (Agassiz–Harrison) runs along Yale Road through Rosedale, with timepoints at Yale Road at McGrath Road and Highway 9 at Yale Road, per BC Transit's Rider's Guide (effective June 28, 2026).
School in Rosedale itself, Ministry-listed: Rosedale Traditional Community, 50850 Yale Rd, Rosedale, V0X 1X2 (SD33, Elementary).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect park-home buyers in Rosedale

items.t: Jurisdiction / taxes: Rosedale parcels are unincorporated (FVRD Area D): the rural property-tax regime under the Taxation (Rural Area) Act s.11 applies — 5% penalty after Jul 2 and a further 5% after Oct 31 — DISTINCT from the City of Chilliwack schedule (5% Jul 2 + 5% Aug 4, 2026, which does NOT apply here) and DISTINCT from Mission's flat 10% penalty (which is expressly NOT applied to rural ground). Parcel-level notice/due-date detail beyond that regime: confirm with the Province/FVRD for the specific parcel.
The mailing shorthand misleads: "Rosedale, Chilliwack" addresses sit in FVRD Area D — a buyer who diligence-checks City of Chilliwack bylaws for a Rosedale parcel is checking the wrong government.
Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park (107 ha, 53480 Elgey Road) is an FVRD park in Area D, open 7 a.m. to sunset, pets not permitted under FVRD Bylaw No. 1500, 2018.

The rural regime: 5% after Jul 2 + 5% after Oct 31 (Taxation (Rural Area) Act s.11) — not Chilliwack's City dates and not Mission's flat 10%.

faq.q: Is Rosedale part of the City of Chilliwack?
faq.a: No — Rosedale is an unincorporated community in FVRD Electoral Area D, east of Chilliwack; the FVRD places its Rosedale-addressed Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park in Electoral Area D and is the local government for its electoral areas, so FVRD — not City of Chilliwack — planning is the frame to confirm for a parcel.

faq.q: Can I build a second home on a Rosedale farm parcel in the ALR?
faq.a: Under the ALC frame, a parcel may have one principal residence of 500 m² or less and, in some cases, one additional detached residence of up to 90 m² on properties 40 ha or less or up to 186 m² on properties over 40 ha; a secondary suite is permitted only within the principal residence, and local government rules may be more restrictive.

Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park — a 107-hectare FVRD park at 53480 Elgey Road, Rosedale, with a lake, marsh and forest, about 2 km of trails, a floating boardwalk and viewing platforms, open 7 a.m. to sunset, with pets not permitted.
